notes.title: Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

http://store.steampowered.com/app/836110/Time_Tenshi_Paradox_Episode_2/

Exciting news! The all-new Episode 2 of Time Tenshi Paradox is now available on Steam!

Discover the mysterious newcomer along with Tessa, Rose, Kyo and the team at the link above!

- Silver Cow Studio

notes.title: Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2 - New teaser!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We received lots of guesses about the name of the mysterious newcomer in Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2!

One was CORRECT (but we're not saying which) - so here's a new teaser!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387289/969f49c39ccbbdfb3f7a6ccbe376e25f345f48fa.jpg
(Click for full size)

Thanks guys, and we hope you're looking forward to Episode 2 as much as we are!

- Silver Cow Studio

notes.title: Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2 - Announcement & Teaser!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're super excited to officially reveal that Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2 is in development, and things are progressing really well!

As a special teaser, we've included a preview of a brand new girl who'll be appearing in this exciting upcoming episode!
What's more, if you can manage to successfully guess her name, we might just reveal a little more detail!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387289/aef4a17882ca20ea6a480835b18254743f820e79.jpg
(Click for full size)

Thanks guys, and we hope you'll look forward to playing in the near future!

- Silver Cow Studio

notes.title: Episode 2 Sneak Peek: Tessa's Time Suit! (Patreon)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Firstly, thanks for your great support of Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 1 so far! We're really glad to see you guys have been enjoying the story so much!

We've posted up a special preview of Tessa's new Time Suit over on our Patreon! This Time Suit will be the one she uses in future episodes of Time Tenshi Paradox, so here's your chance to get an early look at what she'll be wearing!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387289/48c12076c4a2e1b4e9b4d2163622738ce28ad222.png

Thanks all, and we hope you'll look forward to playing the next episode soon!

- Silver Cow Studio
